subject: SOC 2 evidence playbook and expansion procurement timeline
messages:
From: Michelle Torres <michelle.torres@brightline.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightline.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence for expansion procurement

Hi Priya,

We're kicking off procurement for an expansion of our contract and need to confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 posture and any interim coverage you can provide. Quick asks from our security and procurement teams: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (reporting period and auditor name).
- Any interim "bridge" letter or attestation if the Type II report period doesn't cover our renewal/contract effective date.
- SIG/CAIQ detail or a filled spreadsheet for our assessors.

Procurement deadline to get final security clearance is Sept 15, 2026; legal would like any bridge language by Sept 1 so they can include it in the SOW.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an expected turnaround? Also let me know if you need our SIG template (we can share).

Thanks,
Michelle Torres
Head of Security Programs
Brightline Systems

Attachments: none (we'll attach SIG template if helpful)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Torres <michelle.torres@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence for expansion procurement

Hi Michelle — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a draft bridge letter; we can also start a SIG/CAIQ response and map to your template.

What I'll deliver this week:
- Copy of our SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — reporting period covers 2024-12-01 through 2025-11-30, auditor: Horizon Audit Partners.
- Draft bridge letter for the interim window (we typically cover specific control statements and a limited assurance paragraph; I'll circulate a draft by 08/30).
- SIG spreadsheet/CAIQ high-level responses in XLSX by early next week.

A couple of clarification items so we tailor the bridge correctly:
1) Is the procurement asking for coverage for all Redwood services or specifically the hosted API endpoints (production inference only)?
2) Do legal/security need the auditor contact for verification, or will a bridge + report suffice?

I've attached a short one-pager that summarizes our audit scope and standard bridge language we use for renewals. If you can share the SIG template, we'll map answers directly.

Next steps: I will circulate the SOC 2 PDF and the initial bridge draft to you and your legal contacts on 08/30. If Marissa or Karthik have suggestions on wording for procurement, I'm looping them now.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf (summary of scope and typical bridge clauses)
From: Michelle Torres <michelle.torres@brightline.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightline.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence for expansion procurement

Thanks, Priya — that timeline works. To answer your clarifications:

- Coverage: procurement needs the bridge to expressly cover hosted API production endpoints (we're expanding usage of inference in our product pipeline).
- Auditor verification: legal has requested the auditor name and a point of contact so they can validate the report metadata; a phone/email contact is sufficient.

Required bridge items (legal asked me to be specific so you can include them in the draft):
- Statement that controls tested in the Type II report continue to operate through a defined interim period (please specify start/end dates).
- Any changes to service scope or subservice organizations since the last report.
- Confirmation of no material exceptions identified since the last report that would affect control effectiveness.

We can send the SIG template this afternoon (procurement@brightline.com). Also, for CAIQ: our security team prefers an XLSX export that maps each CAIQ question to Redwood's control evidence or doc link.

If you can get the bridge draft and auditor contact by 08/30 we can get legal review and aim to sign by the Sept 1 internal target.

Appreciate it,
Michelle

Attachments: none
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Torres <michelle.torres@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence for expansion procurement

Michelle — attaching the materials and a draft bridge letter per your requested language. Key items included:

- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025-11.pdf (Horizon Audit Partners) — covers 2024-12-01 through 2025-11-30.
- draft_bridge_letter_20260830.docx — draft includes: interim coverage through 2026-09-30 for hosted production inference endpoints, statement of no material exceptions since the report period, and a short paragraph about scope continuity (no new subservice providers impacting controls).
- SIG_response_2026.xlsx — our initial mapping to your SIG template; we'll complete any follow-ups after you send the completed template back with specific question IDs.
- CAIQ_summary_2026.xlsx — top-level CAIQ exports and links to internal evidence docs.

Auditor contact: Horizon Audit Partners
- Name: Daniel Park, Senior Manager, Horizon Audit Partners
- Email: daniel.park@horizonaudit.com
- Phone: +1-415-555-0199

Internal notes for Marissa/Karthik (forwarding below):
> Marissa/Karthik — Michelle asked for bridge by 09/01. I've attached the draft and auditor contact. Legal will want precise wording; recommend Marissa review section 2 (assurance paragraph) before we finalize. If acceptable, sign-off path: Priya -> Marissa -> Legal -> Client.

Michelle, if the draft looks good to you, we can route for legal signature and the auditor verification concurrently. Let me know if you want redlines or a call to walk through wording.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
